delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. Nearby, a tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. Nearby, a tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates. Someone jabs at the board in Cinderwatch Gate District, impatient with anyone who reads too long.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. Nearby, a tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates. Someone jabs at the board in Cinderwatch Gate District, impatient with anyone who reads too long.

A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line, while a gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. Nearby, a tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near a rain barrel. A notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line, while a gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. Nearby, a tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near a rain barrel. A notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line, while a gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. Nearby, a tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near a rain barrel. A notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

entries.content: The muddy ground squishes underfoot, and the cold rain soaks through your cloak, mingling with the smells of damp leather and wood smoke.
You arrive at Old Milestone. A weathered milestone leans beside the northwest mud track, where the road thins into scrub and standing rainwater.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

delivered_exchanges.delivered_text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone beneath frayed banners that hang limply above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a quiet contrast to the muddied clamor of the gate district. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing forward as guards hold the choke point firmly. Near the gate, a gate serjeant manages the crowd with practiced eyes, intermittently glancing at the roster board. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, while a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors beside a rain barrel. The notice board nearby catches your eye, listing the new taxes and curfews imposed by the city, and prominently featuring a warning about a missing patrol. Ash Compact census delays have also tightened the eastern caravan's choke point, adding to the tension and chaos in the area.
You examine the Notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.
